meta.name: ink-cluster
meta.description: Topic cluster architecture builder — takes a core topic and maps the full cluster with 1 pillar page, 6-10 supporting posts, internal linking map, keyword targets, and estimated monthly search volume per piece. Use when asked to "build a content cluster", "map our SEO cluster for [topic]", "create a topic cluster", or "what should our pillar page be about".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为任意主题构建完整的内容集群架构，包括支柱页、支持文章和内链规划。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要围绕核心主题系统规划内容结构和SEO目标。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically plan content structure and SEO targets around a core topic.

howto.what: 当你给出一个核心主题时，Claude 会生成一个完整的主题集群方案，包括一个支柱页面、6-10篇支持文章、内部链接图、每个页面的目标关键词和预估月搜索量，以及发布顺序。
howto.when: 当你要求“构建内容集群”、“为[主题]映射SEO集群”、“创建主题集群”或询问“支柱页面应该关于什么”时触发。

say.text: 为“远程团队管理”构建一个内容集群。
say.note: Claude 会生成集群方案，包括支柱页和文章列表。

say.text: 我们的支柱页面应该关于什么？主题是“AI写作工具”。
say.note: Claude 会给出支柱页标题和关键词建议。

howto.what_en: When you give a core topic, Claude produces a complete topic cluster plan including 1 pillar page, 6-10 supporting posts, an internal linking map, target keywords, estimated monthly search volume per piece, and a publishing sequence.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "build a content cluster", "map our SEO cluster for [topic]", "create a topic cluster", or "what should our pillar page be about".

say_en.text: Build a content cluster for "remote team management".
say_en.note: Claude will generate the cluster plan with pillar and posts.

say_en.text: What should our pillar page be about? Topic is "AI writing tools".
say_en.note: Claude will provide pillar title and keyword suggestions.
